trends.title: Wellness Tourism Surge Reshaping Pricing Bands
trends.summary: Premium positioning is gaining traction across Chiang Mai and Phuket corridors as international wellness tourists accept 40–60% price premiums over local rates. Operators who upgraded environments in Q1 are now seeing measurable return-visit uplift.
patterns: Premium tier listings (+฿800/hr) growing at 2.3× the rate of budget tier
Foreign-language profiles correlating with 28% higher enquiry-to-visit conversion
Weekend surge pricing adopted by 34% of sampled operators

trends.title: Traditional Thai Massage Identity Under Renegotiation
trends.summary: A generational split is visible in how operators present credential authenticity. Younger operators lean into wellness-lifestyle branding while veterans emphasise lineage and technique specificity. Both cohorts are performing well, suggesting the market is bifurcating rather than converging.
patterns: Nuad Boran terminology appearing 3× more in listings targeting over-35 domestic visitors
English-language 'relaxation' framing dominant in tourist-corridor channels
Certification claims increasing — ITM, Wat Pho cited in 18% of premium listings

trends.title: Baht Appreciation Pressure on Cross-Border Worker Supply
trends.summary: Anecdotal reports from five channels suggest a tightening of Myanmar-origin worker availability, potentially linked to baht strength reducing remittance value. If the pattern holds, mid-tier operators relying on this labour pool may face margin compression by Q3.
patterns: Worker availability complaints up 22% week-over-week in operator discussion threads
Wage negotiation posts emerging in channels previously silent on compensation
Solo-operator listings growing as team-based operations pause expansion

trends.title: Chinese Visitor Segment Returning — Different Behaviour Profile
trends.summary: Post-2024 Chinese tourist return is confirmed in channel traffic data, but the behavioural signature differs markedly from pre-pandemic norms. Group bookings are down; individual advance-research visits are up. This segment now exhibits high digital-touchpoint behaviour before first contact.
patterns: LINE QR code scanning requests up 41% in channels with documented Chinese traffic
Mandarin-language profile elements correlating with 2.1× higher photo-view rate
Shorter sessions (60 min) preferred over legacy 2-hour packages

trends.title: Licensing Enforcement Rhetoric Intensifying in Official Channels
trends.summary: Municipal announcements in Phuket and Bangkok reference pending inspection drives targeting unlicensed wellness operations. Community channel response shows operators pre-emptively updating credential language and adjusting operating hour visibility — signalling perceived regulatory risk.
patterns: Sudden removal of location-specific identifiers from 12% of tracked listings
Credential language added or updated in 67 profiles within 72 hours of announcement
Discussion volume around 'จดทะเบียน' (registration) spiked 5× above baseline

trends.title: Photo-Verified Listings Commanding Measurable Premium
trends.summary: Analysis of 400 sampled listings reveals that verified-photo profiles (3+ images, human-curated) achieve 31% higher average price per hour and 2.4× longer listing longevity than text-only equivalents. The signal has commercial implications for platform monetisation.
patterns: Average hourly rate: photo-verified ฿620 vs text-only ฿473
Re-posting frequency drops 60% when photo-verification is present
Operators with Maps links AND photos showing highest conversion proxy scores
